business_problem: It wanted to streamline the business and deliver a more connected customer experience using generative AI.
solution_summary: Aditya Birla Capital used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Cosmos DB to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Call-center telephony, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. The overarching goal of using Azure infrastructure is to build company-wide generative AI platforms to serve as copilots for different functions, including one that's already improved contact center agent productivity by 20%.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves grounding context for assistants and search experiences.

solution_components.name: Azure Cosmos DB
solution_components.role: Persists low-latency application data, conversation state, or operational records.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Hosts scalable APIs, microservices, and model-serving workloads in containers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies prebuilt AI capabilities such as language, speech, or vision services within the application flow.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in Azure AI Search, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure Cosmos DB, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
